## Kolect Creator Search (Remote)

Kolect's hosted MCP server lets AI assistants find and vet TikTok, Instagram and YouTube creators for influencer marketing. Describe a campaign in plain language and `search_creators` returns matching creators from a 300M+ creator database with followers, typical views, engagement and a match reason; `lookup_creators` checks creators you already have by profile link or @handle; `check_fake_followers` estimates audience authenticity (0-100) from public metrics; `get_emails` returns public contact emails; `save_creators` and `list_saved_creators` manage shortlists; `get_account` shows the plan and remaining credits.

**Account and credits.** Requires a Kolect account and an API key created at https://app.kolect.ai/agent. Sign-up is free with 90 credits; tool calls use the same credits as the website (searches charge per creator returned, 20 fake follower checks a day are free). Plans: https://www.kolect.ai/pricing

**Authentication.** Send the key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (or `X-Api-Key`). `initialize` and `tools/list` work without a key.

**Data.** Results contain public creator profile data and, for `get_emails`, public contact emails, returned to the assistant the user connected. `save_creators` writes only to the user's own Kolect favorites.
